The '''''Maxion''''' was a [[sky-dreadnaught]] and flagship of the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. Commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Horzao Darr]], the vessel was ornately outfitted with state rooms and often carried important VIPs and Council members.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the ''Maxion'' made first contact with the off-worlders from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] vessel ''[[FarStar]]''. It ferried the New Republic delegation to [[Caballa City]], and was later used by Captain Darr and the New Republic to insert a strike force into the v to rescue [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]].
